items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience / training.
Advanced degree in Accounting, Business, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of demonstrated related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated experience with Oracle Financials

Experience within a customer service oriented environment responding to and meeting/exceeding the needs of the faculty, staff, students and the community and be able to work effectively as an individual, a team member, and with diverse groups.
Demonstrated experience with workflow management within a shared services environment.
Administrative experience in an office environment providing administrative support.
Demonstrated experience with data exporting, tracking, preparation of spreadsheets and documenting transactional back up reports using software applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

Workflow Management: Extensive usage of Smartsheets to manage the workflow of subordinate shared services team members to ensure timely processing of financial and other transactions across the division. Coordinates with other divisional and departmental staff across all DOS units to assist with event planning details. (30% time)

Business Operations Support: Provide operational support to the Financial and Administrative Manager, and corresponding departments as follows: Assists in ensuring the accuracy and appropriateness of all budget and accounting transactions in consultation with the Financial and Administrative Manager. Maintains primary responsibility for Concur financial pre-approver role. Identifies and reviews problems that pertain to financial transactions that may need additional approval and ensures department heads are in consultation with the Dean of Students Leadership team when needed. Ensures implementation of recommended solutions and/or alternatives to these problems. Maintains Primary responsibility for ledger reconciliations across the division(s). May be assigned as Oracle Financials transactional approver, pre-approver, receiver and/or reconciler for departments across the organization in support of the Financial and Administrative Manager. (30% time)

Policy Compliance: Ensures adherence to all UCOP, Campus and Org best practices, policies, and compliance requirements in the areas of financial management and business operations. Assists the Financial and Administrative Manager in ensuring internal financial controls, internal office procedures, and physical security controls are in place. Monitoring and reporting to departmental Directors the unassigned and Concur Travel Expense Reports for all DOS units and facilitating the timely reconciliation of said reports. Continually monitors processes to identify opportunities for improvement and implement efficiencies. (30% time)
Back-up Financial Support: Provides back-up financial and student personnel transactional support for subordinate shared services team members during absences or peak workload periods. (5% time)
Other Duties as Assigned. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Frequently
Perform Calculations: Occasionally
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Frequently
Sit: Frequently
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally

Skills in judgment and decision-making, problem solving, identifying measures of system performance and the actions to improve performance. Troubleshoot issues with tact and provide guidance within policy boundaries.

Familiarity with environment of UC Riverside or comparable academic institution and relevant issues concerning students, staff, and faculty. Knowledge of UC Riverside academic environment and administrative policies and procedures.
Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
Working knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Solid communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff, both verbally and in writing.
Solid organizational skills and ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.

Demonstrated knowledge of supervisory and personnel management skills and strategies to provide oversight of shared services team members, including experience with training and evaluating the performance of diverse team, providing day-to-day oversight.

Knowledge of diversity, equity and inclusion including an understanding of the historical and social context of diversity, equity and inclusion, and of the intersections of identities including but not limited to: race, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religious, ability, immigration status, socio-economic status.

Knowledge, sensitivity and understanding of the social, political, personal and cross-cultural needs, concerns and interests of students and people of intersecting identities in the campus community and thorough understanding of our respective mission, vision and values.
